title: One Lightning Bolt Stretched 477 Miles Across the Sky

scenes.text: One lightning bolt was four hundred seventy-seven miles long.
It struck across the southern United States in April 2020.
The World Meteorological Organization made it an official record.
A different flash over Uruguay and Argentina lasted a record seventeen seconds.
Most lightning is over in a blink. These spread sideways across the sky.
Four hundred seventy-seven miles. One bolt.

description:
A megaflash that stretched about 477 miles across the southern US in April 2020 set the world record for distance.
Another flash in June 2020 over Uruguay and Argentina lasted about 17 seconds.
Have you ever seen a huge storm?
first_comment: What's the biggest storm you've ever seen?
